items.title: International Business Machines (IBM) Puts Quantum Encryption To Work On Heron R2
items.summary: International Business Machines (NYSE:IBM) supported Quantum X Labs in running an advanced quantum encryption trial on its Quantum Heron r2 processor. The Quantum X Labs experiment used IBM hardware to test an information theoretic security protocol for quantum secured communications in commercial settings.
